claims.statement: Rhee unambiguously demanded withdrawal of all US infantry on May24
claims.preciseConflict: Korean AP report records May24 public denial and request for more UN forces; US Defense/State cite May18 reported remarks and criticize implications. Different statements/dates must not be conflated.
claims.adversarialMethod: Contemporaneous Korean press rebuttal vs US military and diplomatic correspondence

claims.statement: Counterpart 6000 won per USD had final approval by May29
claims.preciseConflict: May29 newspaper says de facto concession expected; US June6 reports Rhee proposed holding 2500 official rate, June9 reports reluctant 6000 counterpart approval. Dates and different rates matter.
claims.adversarialMethod: Press rumor vs diplomatic followup and subsequent reported cabinet approval

claims.statement: May31 Im Mun-hwan only proposed dissolution, no legal act followed
claims.preciseConflict: June1 gazette notice 62 orders dissolution as of May31 under ordinance art11; liquidation and assets transfer still unverified.
claims.adversarialMethod: Minister speech vs subsequent official gazette transcription

claims.statement: Shinjeong caucus held exactly 70 members at May29 merger
claims.preciseConflict: Pre-merger article says 70; June1 editorial says 68; inauguration reports 108 total. Roster needed to reconcile.
claims.adversarialMethod: Two newspapers and party inaugural count

claims.statement: May29 notice 13 proves all 42 designated enterprises were operating profitably
claims.preciseConflict: Designation under vested-property regulation not financial operating status or ownership ledger.
claims.adversarialMethod: Official notice reprint vs missing enterprise accounts

claims.statement: All Chosun Textile accused remained before military court through May31
claims.preciseConflict: Cabinet May25 planned civil/military split; prosecutor May31 reports file transfer May30. Defendant-level final jurisdiction and outcomes unverified.
claims.adversarialMethod: Cabinet communique vs prosecutor later statement and hearing transcript

claims.statement: UK May30 refugee count 3m directly contradicts Korean May31 total 5,758,435
claims.preciseConflict: Different date, geographical and category definitions; Korea table also mixes provincial survey dates. Not a strict contradiction.
claims.adversarialMethod: British parliamentary question vs Korean Social Ministry table

claims.statement: Busan cotton fabric price rose from 3300 to 13300 within one day
claims.preciseConflict: May31 fabric 광목 1마 13,300 vs June1 3,300 in same newspaper and market. Could be transcription, unit, or market change; original pages required.
claims.adversarialMethod: Adjacent-day same-paper unit/price adversarial comparison

claims.statement: Agriculture May25 notice 60 shows farmers actually received 15400 won per sack
claims.preciseConflict: Gazette purchase price schedule not settlement receipts; Suwon grain payment delays show separate implementation issue.
claims.adversarialMethod: Gazette price rule vs local payment record

claims.statement: Government approved and delivered 1931t cotton yarn plus 155t rayon by May25
claims.preciseConflict: Minister described future arrival/allocation; customs and factory receipt missing.
claims.adversarialMethod: Future tense and delivery ledger challenge

claims.statement: Commerce trade-license authority was already fully transferred May29
claims.preciseConflict: Minister said to transfer upon Finance consent; no transfer decree or executed permit ledger.
claims.adversarialMethod: Proposed transfer vs missing implementation decree

claims.statement: Central Wholesale Market Act passed both houses and entered force June1
claims.preciseConflict: Only first reading and opposition reported; second reading and promulgation unverified.
claims.adversarialMethod: Legislative stage adversarial search

claims.statement: Tax-office closure figures establish all shops closed permanently
claims.preciseConflict: Temporary vs permanent filing and active trade are separate; later sanctions were threatened not adjudicated.
claims.adversarialMethod: Tax return vs actual operation and enforcement

claims.statement: Rhee congratulation proves formal presidential command of Gonghwa Minjeong
claims.preciseConflict: Rhee explicitly discusses perceptions of presidential party backing; speech does not prove organizational command or whip control.
claims.adversarialMethod: First-person statement vs caucus roster and independent editorial

claims.statement: May31 refugee totals can be added as unique persons
claims.preciseConflict: Refugees, returnees, aided persons overlap and different survey dates; avoid adding categories.
claims.adversarialMethod: Statistical denominator audit

claims.statement: May31 Assembly ceasefire resolution had already been adopted
claims.preciseConflict: Ten members submitted motion pending committee and plenary consideration.
claims.adversarialMethod: Proposal vs roll-call and journal

claims.statement: 1951 summer grain harvest actually fell 46 percent
claims.preciseConflict: Agriculture Ministry June1 reported forecast 4.256m vs prior actual 7.884m seok; final harvest statistics not supplied.
claims.adversarialMethod: Forecast vs final official production

claims.statement: June1 youth corps nominee list means a successor was elected
claims.preciseConflict: Competing recommendations and pending verdict for former commander; no election or appointment record.
claims.adversarialMethod: Factional press report vs election roster

claims.statement: 1951 JCS 92831 consolidated directives were final orders on May31
claims.preciseConflict: Text explicitly says clearance by Secretary of Defense and President pending.
claims.adversarialMethod: Draft vs final clearance

claims.statement: May29 jeep seizure order proves actual vehicles seized and compensation paid
claims.preciseConflict: Public martial-law announcement contains exceptions and planned search; inventories/compensation not shown.
claims.adversarialMethod: Order vs requisition and payment registers

claims.statement: Foreign Supply Administration procedure proves relief supplies reached intended households
claims.preciseConflict: Logistics assignment not proof of shipment, handoff or recipient receipt.
claims.adversarialMethod: Administrative procedure vs distribution ledgers

claims.statement: May31 Assembly party caucus report and June1 editorial establish an uncontested fixed membership count
claims.preciseConflict: Shinjeong 70 vs 68 and merger 108; members may have changed, must check official membership roll.
claims.adversarialMethod: Independent contemporary publication comparison

claims.statement: 1951 caucus representative 李鍾郁 is automatically identical to canonical 李宗郁
claims.preciseConflict: Hanja variants differ, no roster or original person identity document yet; separate candidate node created with correctionHistory.
claims.adversarialMethod: Crosscheck contemporary original Hanja against existing registry alias and seek original Assembly roster

claims.statement: The May1951 Commerce Minister surnamed Kim in newspapers was definitively canonical Kim Hun
claims.preciseConflict: Only 金 surname in examined newspaper transcription, so provisional candidate until ministerial appointment Gazette verifies full name.
claims.adversarialMethod: Named-role verification against contemporaneous source
